english.title: Infringe copyright in work by communicating work to the public
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) infringed copyright in a work by communicating the work to the public knowing or having reason to believe that you infringed copyright in the work and
(A)_[intending to make a gain for yourself or another person]_
(B)_[that communicating the work to the public would cause loss to the owner of the copyright, or would expose the owner of the copyright to a risk of loss]_
english.legislation: Contrary to section 107(2A) of the Copyright, Designs and Patents Act 1988.
english.pointstoprove:

investigatoraction.description: DNA Samples: If crime scene stain present - take evidential sample If no crime scene stain and DNA not confirmed on PNC - take Criminal Justice sample. If DNA confirmed on PNC - CJ sample not required
Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

english.notes:
As stated in subsection (2B) for the purposes of subsection 2A -
(a) 'gain' and 'loss' -
(ii) extend only to gain or loss in money, and (ii) include any such gain or loss whether temporary or permanent, and (b) 'loss' includes a loss by not getting what one might get.

other.penalty:
SUMMARY: Three months imprisonment and / or a fine not exceeding £50,000.
INDICTMENT: Ten years imprisonment and / or a fine.

Time limit for prosecutions:
None
